description: This short circular walk visits the Kyson Hill viewpoint in Woodbridge. You can start the walk from the car park just south of Woodbridge Quay. From here you can pick up riverside paths along the River Deben to reach Kyson Hill. The small hill is owned by the National Trust and is a nice spot to enjoy a view across the river. The walk can be extended by exploring Martlesham Creek to the south west.
